Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly stated joining years for Fubo management—claiming David Gandler joined in April 2020 and John Janedis in March 2020—without verifying against authoritative sources. In reality, Gandler co-founded Fubo in 2015, and Janedis became CFO in 2022. This reliance on unverified or misread search results led to the wrong conclusion about who joined in the IPO year (2020).
